integrity: The proof derives an exact recurrence and classification for fixed-point difference sets, then counts factor Parikh vectors by substitution-block boundary type. A standalone verifier independently checks the coordinate rule, difference-set classification, translation symmetry, and direct factor complexities over substantial finite ranges.
scientific_limitations: The result gives one explicit ternary Parikh-constant counterexample and its complete abelian-complexity formula. It does not characterize ultimate periodicity for all Parikh-constant morphisms.
title: A Parikh-constant fixed point with aperiodic abelian complexity
